ddl.where: "session_group"."kind" = 'plugin' AND "session_group"."owner_plugin" IS NOT NULL AND "session_group"."owner_ref" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: session_group_plugin_owner_ref_idx

ddl.where: "session_input"."user_preemptible" = 1 AND "session_input"."promoted_seq" IS NULL AND "session_input"."revoked_seq" IS NULL
ddl.name: session_input_session_preemptible_seq_idx

ddl.where: "session"."parent_id" IS NULL AND "session"."time_archived" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: session_directory_root_archived_id_idx

ddl.where: "swarm_claim"."released_at" IS NULL AND "swarm_claim"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: swarm_claim_expiry_idx

ddl.value: ("state" = 'released' and "released_at" is not null) or ("state" <> 'released' and "released_at" is null)
ddl.name: directory_activity_lease_release_check

ddl.value: ("state" = 'released' and "released_at" is not null) or ("state" <> 'released' and "released_at" is null)
ddl.name: directory_maintenance_guard_release_check

ddl.value: length("directory") > 0 and length("installation_id") > 0 and length("repository_id") > 0 and length("worktree_id") > 0 and length("storage_volume_id") > 0 and length("project_id") > 0 and length("branch_ref") > 0
ddl.name: managed_worktree_binding_identity_check

ddl.value: ("pin_ref" is null or length("pin_ref") > 0) and ("manager_revision" is null or "manager_revision" > 0)
ddl.name: managed_worktree_binding_observation_check

ddl.value: ("binding_state" <> 'active') or ("head" is not null and "manager_revision" is not null and "lifecycle_state" is not null and "activated_at" is not null)
ddl.name: managed_worktree_binding_activation_check

ddl.value: ("binding_state" = 'retired' and "retired_at" is not null) or ("binding_state" <> 'retired' and "retired_at" is null)
ddl.name: managed_worktree_binding_retirement_check

ddl.value:
(
        "state" = 'auth-invalid'
        and "credential_revision" is not null
        and "credential_revision" > 0
        and "credential_revision" <= 9007199254740991
        and "expires_at" is null
      ) or (
        "state" in ('cooling-down', 'quota-exhausted')
        and "credential_revision" is null
        and "expires_at" is not null
        and "expires_at" > "observed_at"
        and "expires_at" <= 9007199254740991
      )
ddl.name: provider_account_route_health_shape_check

ddl.value:
(
        "route_kind" = 'public'
        and "account_id" is null
        and "credential_handle" is null
        and "mode" is null
        and "pin" is null
      ) or (
        "route_kind" = 'account'
        and "account_id" is not null
        and length("account_id") > 0
        and "credential_handle" is not null
        and length("credential_handle") > 0
      )
ddl.name: provider_route_binding_identity_check
